name: Bernardo II of Kongo
contribution: A manikongo of the Kingdom of Kongo who ruled from 12 August 1614 until August 1615.

checks.lead: Bernardo II Nimi a Nkanga was a manikongo of the Kingdom of Kongo who ruled from 12 August 1614 until August 1615. He was the son of King Álvaro II.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
